result_preview.title: Vendor Spend Intelligence
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregates contract, purchase order, and vendor performance data for procurement analytics.

result_preview.title: Procurement Spend Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregated spend metrics and vendor performance trends across purchase orders and contracts.
result_preview.description: A derived analytical data product that consolidates procurement spend data across vendors, purchase orders, and active contracts. It provides pre-calculated KPIs including category spend distribution, vendor spend concentration, contract utilization rates, and period-over-period spend variance. This product enables procurement teams to identify optimization opportunities, monitor vendor performance, and support strategic sourcing decisions.

result_preview.title: Invoice and Material Procurement Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregates invoice and material procurement metrics for spend analysis.
result_preview.description: Summarizes invoice processing trends and material procurement patterns to provide actionable insights into procurement spend, invoice aging, and material cost dynamics. Delivers comprehensive metrics on invoice volumes, payment cycles, and material consumption patterns across the procurement lifecycle.

result_preview.title: Material and Vendor Master Data API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages material specifications and vendor master records for procurement operations.
result_preview.description: This API exposes comprehensive material and vendor master data, enabling systems to retrieve standardized product information, vendor attributes, and procurement-relevant classifications. It provides access to material hierarchies, vendor certifications, compliance statuses, and sourcing preferences to support goods receipt workflows and inbound logistics processing.
